components.name: Button
components.a11y: WCAG AAA · 44px hit target · keyboard focus ring
components.description: Primary interactive trigger used across product flows, dialogs, and form submissions. Consumes semantic primary, radius, and spacing tokens.
dos: Use sentence case and concise action verbs (e.g., 'Publish release', 'Sync variables').
Limit primary buttons to one principal action per viewport surface.
donts: Never hardcode hex colors like #1a5ee5; always bind to color.semantic.primary.
Do not stack two primary buttons side-by-side without visual hierarchy.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis mapped to Dark Matter semantic tokens.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls height (32px, 38px, 44px) and horizontal padding.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces label icon with an inline spinner and disables repeat clicks.

components.name: TextInput
components.description: Single-line form control with prefix/suffix slots, validation states, and monospace token mode.
dos: Always pair inputs with a visible label and clear helper or validation copy.
Use monospace font token (font.family.mono) for token paths, API keys, and SHA hashes.
donts: Do not rely on placeholder text as a substitute for a persistent field label.
Avoid custom border radii; inherit radius.md from the active brand context.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible field label rendered above the input.

props.name: state
props.description: Maps border stroke to semantic border, danger, or success tokens.

components.name: SurfaceCard
components.description: Elevated Dark Matter container for token tables, telemetry metrics, and living documentation blocks.
dos: Keep card density scannable with a maximum of 3 data points per card.
Use 1px solid color.semantic.border for crisp Dark Matter separation.
donts: Do not nest elevated cards inside other elevated cards.
Never override internal padding with arbitrary pixel values.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Controls background surface token and shadow.elevated application.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.a11y: WCAG AA · Status dot + explicit text label
components.description: Compact semantic indicator for component health (Healthy, Known issue, Deprecated) and CI pipeline status.
dos: Pair status color with an unambiguous text label for color-vision accessibility.
Keep badge copy to 1–3 words maximum.
donts: Do not make StatusBadges interactive buttons; use a filter chip or button instead.

props.name: status
props.description: Selects semantic color token and status indicator icon.

components.name: CalloutBanner
components.a11y: role='status' · Missing dark-light high-contrast doc note
components.description: Contextual inline alert block used inside Living Documentation and PR delivery summaries.
components.codeSnippet:
<CalloutBanner intent="warning" title="Token Drift Detected">
  2 components use hardcoded hex values.
</CalloutBanner>
dos: Place callout banners immediately above the relevant code or token table.
donts: Avoid stacking multiple warning banners on the same documentation page.

props.name: intent
props.description: Determines accent bar and icon semantic token.

components.name: DialogModal
components.description: Accessible overlay dialog for branch merges, release publishing, and Figma variable diff approval.
dos: Provide an explicit Cancel action alongside the primary confirmation button.
donts: Do not trigger destructive merges without showing the token diff summary first.

components.name: Button
components.a11y: WCAG AAA · 44px hit target · keyboard focus ring
components.description: Primary interactive trigger used across product flows, dialogs, and form submissions. Consumes semantic primary, radius, and spacing tokens.
dos: Use sentence case and concise action verbs (e.g., 'Publish release', 'Sync variables').
Limit primary buttons to one principal action per viewport surface.
donts: Never hardcode hex colors like #1a5ee5; always bind to color.semantic.primary.
Do not stack two primary buttons side-by-side without visual hierarchy.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis mapped to Dark Matter semantic tokens.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls height (32px, 38px, 44px) and horizontal padding.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces label icon with an inline spinner and disables repeat clicks.

components.name: TextInput
components.description: Single-line form control with prefix/suffix slots, validation states, and monospace token mode.
dos: Always pair inputs with a visible label and clear helper or validation copy.
Use monospace font token (font.family.mono) for token paths, API keys, and SHA hashes.
donts: Do not rely on placeholder text as a substitute for a persistent field label.
Avoid custom border radii; inherit radius.md from the active brand context.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible field label rendered above the input.

props.name: state
props.description: Maps border stroke to semantic border, danger, or success tokens.

components.name: SurfaceCard
components.description: Elevated Dark Matter container for token tables, telemetry metrics, and living documentation blocks.
dos: Keep card density scannable with a maximum of 3 data points per card.
Use 1px solid color.semantic.border for crisp Dark Matter separation.
donts: Do not nest elevated cards inside other elevated cards.
Never override internal padding with arbitrary pixel values.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Controls background surface token and shadow.elevated application.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.a11y: WCAG AA · Status dot + explicit text label
components.description: Compact semantic indicator for component health (Healthy, Known issue, Deprecated) and CI pipeline status.
dos: Pair status color with an unambiguous text label for color-vision accessibility.
Keep badge copy to 1–3 words maximum.
donts: Do not make StatusBadges interactive buttons; use a filter chip or button instead.

props.name: status
props.description: Selects semantic color token and status indicator icon.

components.a11y: role='status' · Missing dark-light high-contrast doc note

dos: Place callout banners immediately above the relevant code or token table.
donts: Avoid stacking multiple warning banners on the same documentation page.

props.name: intent
props.description: Determines accent bar and icon semantic token.

dos: Provide an explicit Cancel action alongside the primary confirmation button.
donts: Do not trigger destructive merges without showing the token diff summary first.

dos: Use sentence case and concise action verbs (e.g., 'Publish release', 'Sync variables').
Limit primary buttons to one principal action per viewport surface.
donts: Never hardcode hex colors like #1a5ee5; always bind to color.semantic.primary.
Do not stack two primary buttons side-by-side without visual hierarchy.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis mapped to Dark Matter semantic tokens.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls height (32px, 38px, 44px) and horizontal padding.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces label icon with an inline spinner and disables repeat clicks.

components.name: TextInput
components.description: Single-line form control with prefix/suffix slots, validation states, and monospace token mode.
dos: Always pair inputs with a visible label and clear helper or validation copy.
Use monospace font token (font.family.mono) for token paths, API keys, and SHA hashes.
donts: Do not rely on placeholder text as a substitute for a persistent field label.
Avoid custom border radii; inherit radius.md from the active brand context.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible field label rendered above the input.

props.name: state
props.description: Maps border stroke to semantic border, danger, or success tokens.

components.name: SurfaceCard
components.description: Elevated Dark Matter container for token tables, telemetry metrics, and living documentation blocks.
dos: Keep card density scannable with a maximum of 3 data points per card.
Use 1px solid color.semantic.border for crisp Dark Matter separation.
donts: Do not nest elevated cards inside other elevated cards.
Never override internal padding with arbitrary pixel values.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Controls background surface token and shadow.elevated application.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.a11y: WCAG AA · Status dot + explicit text label
components.description: Compact semantic indicator for component health (Healthy, Known issue, Deprecated) and CI pipeline status.
dos: Pair status color with an unambiguous text label for color-vision accessibility.
Keep badge copy to 1–3 words maximum.
donts: Do not make StatusBadges interactive buttons; use a filter chip or button instead.

props.name: status
props.description: Selects semantic color token and status indicator icon.

components.name: CalloutBanner
components.a11y: role='status' · Missing dark-light high-contrast doc note
components.description: Contextual inline alert block used inside Living Documentation and PR delivery summaries.
components.codeSnippet:
<CalloutBanner intent="warning" title="Token Drift Detected">
  2 components use hardcoded hex values.
</CalloutBanner>
dos: Place callout banners immediately above the relevant code or token table.
donts: Avoid stacking multiple warning banners on the same documentation page.

props.name: intent
props.description: Determines accent bar and icon semantic token.

components.name: DialogModal
components.description: Accessible overlay dialog for branch merges, release publishing, and Figma variable diff approval.
dos: Provide an explicit Cancel action alongside the primary confirmation button.
donts: Do not trigger destructive merges without showing the token diff summary first.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls modal visibility and focus trap activation.
